reason: A command-line plugin that automates installation of three bundled DSH presets into the user preset root without overwriting existing preset directories.

summaries.zh: 通过命令行将三个内置 DSH 预设安装到用户预设目录，并在已有目录时保留其内容。
summaries.en: A command-line plugin that installs three bundled DSH presets into the user preset directory while preserving existing preset directories.

capabilities: Installs bundled preset directories into the configured user preset root
Creates preset directories only when they do not already exist
Writes installation marker files and logs per-preset failures
